leh-manali-highway-manali-lachulung-la.title: Leh–Manali Highway: Manali to Lachulung La
leh-manali-highway-manali-lachulung-la.slogan: Manali to Lachulung La, over 5059 m · one way, about 291 km back to the start

waypoints.name: Manali
waypoints.advice: Manali is where the day begins. Next is Atal Tunnel north portal.

waypoints.advice: 146 km in you reach Baralacha La. Next is Sarchu, mostly downhill.

sections.advice: Manali → Atal Tunnel north portal is 23 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Atal Tunnel north portal → Baralacha La climbs about 4890 m in 56 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Baralacha La → Sarchu drops about 4890 m over 38 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Sarchu → Lachulung La climbs about 5059 m in 30 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.

scenicChapters.title: Leh–Manali Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: For 45 km this is Leh–Manali Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Manali-Leh Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace. 4890 m come off over 75 km at around 13.0%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it.

scenicChapters.title: Leh–Manali Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 16.8%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter — first and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.

leh-manali-highway-manali-lachulung-la.story: 291 km from Manāli to the finish, about 4 h of riding. It goes by way of Atal Tunnel north portal, Baralacha La and Sarchu. The highest point is about 5,100 m. Baralacha La and Lachulung La are open in summer only - check it is open before you set off. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
